response.original_title: F. Scott Fitzgerald: The Great American Dreamer
response.overview: Tells the story of F. Scott Fitzgerald, author of The Great Gatsby, and his wife Zelda, from their origins in Minnesota, through the roaring ‘20s, Zelda’s institutionalization, and Scott’s literary success that came only after his life.
response.title: F. Scott Fitzgerald: The Great American Dreamer
